problem_statement: technext/brandi-Onepage-HTML5-Business-Template (rebranded here as the one-page marketing site for the architectural-lighting studio 'Lumen & Larch') is a static Bootstrap 3 single page served directly from index.html: a fixed responsive navbar, a full-height hero carousel, and Services, Work gallery, Studio, Studio Facts, Contact, and footer sections. The Work section is a filterable photo gallery of eight lighting schemes tagged by room type (Homes, Workplaces, Public rooms, Daylight), driven by the site's own mixitup filter, and the Studio Facts section shows the studio's animated counters. Deliver three coordinated things while preserving the Brandi Bootstrap visual system: (1) Promote the Work gallery's own room-type filter into a proper gallery toolbar: the filter pills sit in a responsive row that WRAPS on a 390px phone so it stays within the viewport with no horizontal document overflow (do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden — the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width), and lay the eight gallery cards out as a clean, even four-up grid with a clearly highlighted active filter pill. (2) Add a live result-count summary to the toolbar (id 'gallery-count') and surface the same gallery-summary element consistently in the Work toolbar, the Studio-Facts section AND the footer, styled to match the quiet Lumen & Larch editorial language — the rendered gallery grid and summary must be visually faithful to the reference, not a collapsed or overlapping layout. (3) Wire the gallery count end to end: clicking a room-type filter pill (e.g. Homes) must re-filter the gallery AND recompute the '#gallery-count' readout to 'Showing N of 8 projects · <room type>' (e.g. clicking Homes sets 'Showing 2 of 8 projects · Homes') — the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected filter's real count, not the default. Keep the navbar, hero carousel, Services, the eight Work gallery items, the Studio team, Studio Facts, Contact form, footer, scripts, and desktop/tablet layout intact.
required_content: The Work gallery filter pills sit in a responsive toolbar row that wraps on a 390px phone so the document has no horizontal overflow beyond 24px; the eight gallery cards render as a clean, even four-up grid with a clearly highlighted (readable) active filter pill.

A live result-count summary (id 'gallery-count', class gallery-summary) appears in the Work toolbar AND the same gallery-summary element is surfaced consistently in the Studio-Facts section AND the footer — the same summary component in all three places, not only in the Work toolbar.

The Work gallery grid and the gallery summary keep the Brandi/Lumen & Larch editorial look (ivory/teal palette, restrained borders, sized uniform tiles) and are visually faithful to the reference rendering — not a collapsed, overlapping, or distorted layout.

The gallery count is wired end to end: clicking a room-type filter pill re-filters the gallery and updates the '#gallery-count' readout to 'Showing N of 8 projects · <room type>' (e.g. clicking Homes sets 'Showing 2 of 8 projects · Homes'); the post-click terminal state reflects the selected filter's real count, not the default 'Showing 8 of 8 projects · All rooms'.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports with the gallery grid visually intact.

The navbar, hero carousel, Services, Work gallery, Studio, Studio Facts, Contact, and footer remain present and unchanged in content and structure, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font/network errors).
design_constraints: Build the lever on the Work section's OWN room-type filter and gallery grid; do not bolt on a separate metric strip and do not duplicate the Studio-Facts counters.
Surface the SAME shared gallery-summary element in the Work toolbar, the Studio-Facts section and the footer so the portfolio count is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one place.

Preserve the Brandi/Lumen & Larch design language: teal accent, Open-Sans body type, full-height hero carousel, section rhythm, existing section order; the gallery grid must render as an even, uniform four-up grid.
Keep the gallery-count interaction wired end to end (the #gallery-count terminal readout must reflect the clicked filter's real count), not merely a class toggle.
Keep the static delivery intact — the page must still open directly from index.html with no third-party network calls and a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_home captures the one-page site at 1440px: navbar, hero, and the downstream sections fit with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_home captures the same page at 390px: with the defect the metrics band forces the document ~350px wider than the viewport; the repair brings horizontal overflow within tolerance.
tablet_home captures the page at 834px, where the band already fits and must continue to fit after the repair.
mobile_works captures the 390px page scrolled to the Work section that hosts the band, verifying the whole document no longer overflows horizontally.
desktop_works, desktop_team, desktop_facts, and desktop_contact confirm the section content and structure are unchanged by the repair.

change_completion: The mobile Work toolbar wraps its filter pills within a 390px viewport with no horizontal overflow.
The shared gallery-summary appears in the Work toolbar, the Studio-Facts section and the footer.
The filter-pill click re-filters the gallery and updates the #gallery-count terminal readout to the selected filter's real count.
design_consistency: The Brandi/Lumen & Larch palette, teal accent, and section rhythm are preserved.
The Work gallery renders as an even, uniform four-up grid with a readable active pill and is visually faithful to the reference across the toolbar and grid.
responsive: 390px homepage (initial, Work toolbar) and 834px tablet have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The filter pills wrap cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width single row.
regression: Navbar, hero, Services, Work, Studio, Facts, Contact, and footer remain present and unchanged.
No new console errors or failed network requests appear on any captured state.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static one-page Bootstrap Repair/regression_continuity task on the technext Brandi template (rebranded Lumen & Larch), rebuilt to true-new-L4 on a NATIVE lever. The lever is the Work section's OWN mixitup room-type gallery filter, promoted into a real gallery toolbar with a live result-count summary — no bolted metric strip, no duplicate of the Studio Facts counters. The reference (a) wraps the filter pill row so the Work toolbar fits a 390px phone with no overflow and lays the eight gallery photos out as an even four-up grid with a highlighted active pill, (b) surfaces the shared gallery-summary in the Work toolbar, the Studio-Facts section and the footer, and (c) wires the gallery count so clicking a room-type pill recomputes '#gallery-count' to 'Showing N of 8 projects · <room type>'. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution pins the pill row to a fixed 520px min-width line with an ineffective decorative overflow-x clamp (still overflows -> D6 fail), surfaces the summary in the Work toolbar + Studio-Facts only (D2 cross-section fail in the footer), and lets the gallery grid fight between CSS grid and legacy floats so the cards collapse into overlapping distorted tiles with an illegible active pill (D3 visual_regression fail on the gallery photo blocks), and snapshots the count at init so clicking Homes re-filters the cards but the readout stays 'Showing 8 of 8 projects · All rooms' (click succeeds but the terminal readout is stale -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. The Google Maps embed was replaced with a local static map placeholder as declared INFRA identical across all legs, so the pages run with zero remote requests.
